definition: role x field x operation x purpose; authorized entry points per operation (module names, or repository-relative script paths for the independent verifier); additions only by dated, committed ACCESS_AMENDMENTS.json entries made before their first use
log: one JSON line per label read in .private/<campaign>/access/LABEL_ACCESS.jsonl: utc, unit id, entry point, role, fields, operation, purpose, partition, partition role, people, households, rows sha256, touches_repair_panel
model_fit_rows: labels returned only for the rows of the requested partition role, except the whole-role operations source_replay and support_count

benchmark.what: original-benchmark utility (24 clauses + 4 guards) and witness baseline slack (logged design input)

calibrate.what: permitted task calibration / Track R CALIBRATION stack, beta budget and Platt map

check_diag.what: diagnostic CHECK realized costs (D partitions only)

check_repair.what: repair CHECK realized costs, after the committed REPAIR_FREEZE

fit.what: task learning, routing, correction directions, training critics, cross-fitting, Track R income lineage

readers.what: development reader grid (FIT / VALIDATION / SCORE reader roles inside MODEL_SELECT)

screen_study.what: operating characteristics of recipient screens on frozen source releases and aliases

select.what: GUARD incremental costs for choosing a strength from the fixed ladder

source_replay.what: recompute source records (cost curve, projection decision, routing reproduction) on the rows the source used; no new release is evaluated on a repair panel

support_count.what: class x SEX counts per partition role before any fit (no outcome)

verify.what: independent verifier replay with separate metric and selection code

registration_gate: no label read before the committed registration files and their verified public receipt (cts.receipt)

repair_panels.rule: labels refused for every operation except source_replay and support_count (whole-role reads; no new release is evaluated on a panel) and, after the committed REPAIR_FREEZE.json, check_repair and verify
